steps.content: The woman in front of you sits elegantly in the interrogation seat, looking like she could be about to start a TV show.
She greets you with a warm smile as you walk in.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Great to meet again, Chief ${PlayerName}.
You hold the latest updates in your hands, looking at the woman before you, her smile gentle and reassuring, as you quietly take a deep breath.

options: It's only been a few hours since we last met.

choices.text: It's only been a few hours since we last met.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You look a little on edge, is everything alright?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Why so tense? We both saw it, didn't we? The ultimate threat... it's been dealt with, and now I'm right here with you.
The ultimate threat? Are you talking about that vintage terminal, or something else...?
I caught sight of the announcement when I was returning from the TV station.
They've put your radio program on an indefinite hiatus...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hmm, I know that.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I was the one who went to negotiate that personally.
You went there in person?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Right... To be honest, I've been ready to come here for a while. The world beyond... there's no need for it to bear my mark.
Your mark...
You sift through the documents next to you, the ones you had put together before stepping out.
So, that's the reason... you wiped the memories of people who got those 3 AM calls?
Eleven appears unexpectedly taken aback that you dug up this info, hesitating for a moment.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You... how on earth did you know?
I'm the head of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. Once I learned that this radio station was behind the Mania Event, investigating it thoroughly was a given.
Just doing my job...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You've got a point there.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: That late-night radio show at 3 am... When I was the host, I had one clear goal: to hear out our audience, to offer solace for their daytime hurts, or calm the emotions that night couldn't quiet.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I had intended for it to be a show that warmed hearts. Obviously, it didn't turn out as planned.
Eleven keeps smiling, but her eyes lower to the floor, almost as though she is mustering up the bravery to speak those hard truths.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Whispers of the weird, swirling rumors, unyielding control of narratives, and constant public condemnation—they've all weighed heavily on me. Ultimately, I couldn't be the beacon of warmth I intended; instead, I turned into a perpetrator in this maelstrom of voices.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: With the root of all this chaos gone, it's a welcome change.
Eleven's voice trails off for a moment before she shrugs nonchalantly.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Indeed, the airwaves are silent, and that final vintage terminal is no more... Call at 3 AM is a thing of the past.
Yet... out there, it appears someone is still getting those calls.
As you speak, a frown forms on Eleven's brow.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: No way.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I might not have the strength to take down that terminal, but now that you're here...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: With your abilities, there's no way it could have gotten away...
Yet, here's the reality.
You push the tablet in front of Eleven, the swiftly scrolling entries on the screen leaving her momentarily flustered.

Post-investigation, searches for <color=#fb9259>"Call at 3 AM"</color> plummet, and you notice that memories of involved individuals are being deliberately wiped. You task the intelligence team to help erase any leads and manage the fallout.
However, moments ago, searches for the term surged back up, gaining traction fast. The rumors now spreading are eerily alike the previous ones.

<size=42><color=#7683a2>[Dismyth Forum][Discussion Board]</color>[Call at 3 AM Strikes Again]</size>

<color=#fb9259>Anonymous Poster</color>: The midnight calls are back! If you're up at 3 a.m., you could get a call from an unknown caller... A lady will share a story and pose a question.

<color=#fb9259>Anonymous Poster</color>: You've got to pick up, you've got to respond! Anyone who hangs up or gets the answer wrong ends up mysteriously dead!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: What... what did it do?!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: It's obviously been ruined already...
Yet, inside, the echoes of Mania are unmistakable. And... just before I got to the skyscraper, it seemed like everyone around, myself included, got this eerie, silent call.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: That's not right, that call was meant for you and you alone...
But, if I'm not mistaken, the voice on the other end of the line was supposed to be "someone else," wasn't it? And... at that moment, you were supposed to be out cold.
You lock eyes with Eleven, but she's the first to break away, conceding the silent battle.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Sorry, I should've been upfront with you from the start.
Better late than never, right? This is exactly why we're here now.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: At the outset, when the world was ending and we fused together, a piece of power escaped... leaving my abilities fragmented...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Moreover... it's constantly rekindling their eerie memories of calls received at 3 AM.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I truly hope they could erase these memories... For anyone who's called in or listened to that broadcast, those memories are anything but fond.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Dragged into a surreal realm, morphing into creatures with freakish heads, forced to utter words against their will, echoing the masses.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I've been on its trail, determined to obliterate it... to regain my strength, and also... to extinguish the "Origin."
Eleven stares intently at the vintage terminal within the evidence bag, as though anticipating its indicator light to suddenly blink on again.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: However, I realized that without this part of my power, I can't control it, nor can I erase it. It overpowers me, attempting to use me once more for its old tricks.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I... I deceived it, claiming that my current power and emotions are insufficient to create another world... but... with someone else's strength added, it surely could...
She raises her head, looking at you somewhat sheepishly.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I used that terminal to call you... My plan was for us to take it down together... but I had no idea it could still reach out to so many people...
Ah, now it makes sense...
Back in the elevator, I figured out it wasn't you on the call, but both of you stem from the same Mania force.
Moreover, I had already found out about your efforts to erase information regarding this radio station, which led me to take a gamble, thinking I had won.
You bring the evidence bag to the center, questioning Eleven.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Lock it up...
Lock it up?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Ah, there's got to be a room around here, a kind of fortress that can totally shut out that Mania. If we stash it in there, we can make sure it doesn't mess with anything outside.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Give it enough time, and these whispers will... well, they'll just disappear. People forget all about spooky stories and shows like this.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The world is full of fascinating things and sounds that are constantly changing, but they all fade away in time.
Are you really going to go through with this, knowing your powers might never come back?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: My power... it's not exactly something to be proud of, right?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: It's brought nothing but trouble to everyone... and it's not like it can make my current predicament any better.
After finishing, Eleven hangs her head, shutting down further conversation.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: What should we try...?
One more use, and I'll unleash the power of these shackles. I'm convinced it'll lead us to some clues.
Eleven's face betrays a moment of doubt.
Don't worry, I'm here. I don't think... it could really create another world.
Upon hearing you, Eleven gives a small nod, lifting the fractured terminal to her ear.
Noticing she's set, you lift your right hand, triggering the power of your shackles.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...Ahhhhh.

Suddenly, there's a noise from the handset of the terminal. Panic creeps into Eleven's voice, uncontainable. That's when you see how ghostly pale she is, biting her lips as though she's hearing something ominous.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Why... why not? Is it impossible to change anything, ever?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hey hey, I didn't...
Eleven's emotions spike, her fingers turning white from gripping the terminal so hard. The room starts to distort, responding to her rising panic, with the Mania sounds assaulting your ears.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: This isn't on me! It's all of you... you've always ignored what I had to say!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You're the ones who cast me aside... because I was too weak... it's on me...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: If that's the case, then I'll just—!
Eleven! Drop it, let it go!

Eleven makes no move to stop you as you latch onto the terminal, but pulling it away is no easy task. The device exerts a powerful pull, freezing you in place, as the room distorts and tightens around you, your consciousness fading.
In the midst of this turmoil, you catch a sinister whisper on the other end of the line—a voice bubbling with anger and ill intent.
A story, with a question.
What I'm really wondering is... Eleven, have you actually... found the voice you've been searching for?
(The hum of electricity intensifies, climaxing in a blinding white flash.)
(The hum of electricity intensifies, climaxing in a blinding white flash.)
Suddenly, the buzzing stops dead. At that moment, the spinning world around you comes to a standstill, your feet at last touching solid ground.
The streets are well-known, but the crowds are unrecognizable. Night falls with a heavy mood, casting an oppressive air over the streets.
Lights shine bright against the deathly stillness.
Next time, I'll think before I speak... Who knew I'd eat my words this fast, actually bringing a whole new world into being...
You can tell immediately this is like the world Eleven had made, but it's clearly a lot less powerful.

The end of the road in sight is shrouded in darkness, not a speck of light. The only path you can see is teeming with people in business attire, all hurrying past you towards the only skyscraper in sight.
It's just you left standing in the throng of people; Eleven is gone.
Out of the blue, someone grabs your arm from behind.

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: You...

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: You... work...
Look, man, if there's something on your mind, let's talk about it. True, I'm on the job at the moment, but...

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: Can't skip it; work's an obligation; I have to get to work...!

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: Time's up... You should be heading... to work too...
Like those you've encountered in the other Mania worlds before, this odd-headed man in a suit grips your arm, the other hand stiffly pointing to a skyscraper far away.
But... my work isn't there...

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: Can't put off work... need to start right away...
Its grip tightens, almost yanking you forcibly towards the office tower.
...So, work over there...
I'm on my way, heading there now...
After all, it's not like I have anywhere else to go.
